text.text:
*Summary*
We agreed to ship the new onboarding checklist on Nov 12 and to keep the old flow behind a flag for two weeks. Billing's annual-plan bug is fixed in 2.4.1; support will tell the three affected customers. Sam is finishing the partner pricing sheet, and finance wants it before Thursday's review.

*Decisions*
•  Ship the onboarding checklist on Nov 12
•  Keep the old onboarding flow behind a flag for two weeks

*Open questions*
•  Do the EU tiers need legal review before the partner review?

ask.where: /markdrop ask How do I connect Postgres?

text.text: Create a read-only user in Postgres, then add it under Settings › Data sources › Postgres with the host, port and database [1]. Connections from Acme come from two fixed IP addresses you can allow in your firewall [2].

*Sources*
`1`  <https://docs.acme.com/guides/setup/connect-postgres|Connect Postgres>
`2`  <https://docs.acme.com/security-faq|Security FAQ>
